cards.text: The writer of Acts opens with a note to a man named Theophilus, reminding him about his first book. That book was about all that Jesus began to do and to teach. Began, friend. And it ran right up to one VERY big day.

cards.question: The writer's first book about Jesus ran right up to which day?

answers.text: The day He was taken up to heaven
The day He was born in Bethlehem
The day He was baptized by John

cards.question: Before that day, Jesus gave instructions to the apostles He had chosen. He gave them through the ___.

cards.text: After His suffering, Jesus presented Himself to the apostles with many convincing proofs that He was alive. That's not a rumor, friend, that's a RECEIPT, and after years under useless receipts in my old junk drawer, trust me, I know which kind you keep.

cards.question: After His suffering, Jesus kept appearing to the apostles. Over how long?
Over those forty days, Jesus spoke to the apostles about the ___ of God.

cards.text: While they're all gathered together, Jesus gives them a command. And it starts with: don't leave.

cards.question: Jesus commands the apostles not to leave which city?
Instead of leaving Jerusalem, what does Jesus tell the apostles to do?

answers.text: Wait for the gift the Father promised
Head out and preach in every town
Pick a new leader to guide them all

cards.text: Wait? Friend, I spent YEARS waiting in the back of a junk drawer, and nobody promised me a THING. These folks are waiting on a promise straight from the Father.

cards.question: Jesus compares the Father's gift to John baptizing with water. True or false: Jesus says their own baptism is still many years away.
Jesus says John baptized with water, but in a few days the apostles will be baptized with the ___.

cards.text: So when the apostles come together, they've got a question for Jesus. A BIG one.

cards.question: The apostles have heard Jesus talk about the kingdom of God. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: Will You restore the kingdom to Israel now
Who will lead us once You are gone
Will You take us with You to heaven

cards.text: Is it now? I get it, friend. That's me opening the oven every thirty seconds going, is it time YET? Is it time YET?

cards.question: When the apostles ask about the timing, what does Jesus tell them?

answers.text: It is not for them to know
It will come in one more year
He will tell them when it is near

cards.question: Jesus says the times and seasons have been fixed by the ___ by His own authority.

cards.text: The timing belongs to the Father. Me? I don't know the day either, friend. I just keep the ovens warm.
But Jesus doesn't stop there. He tells them what's coming when the Holy Spirit comes upon them.

cards.question: What does Jesus say the apostles will receive when the Holy Spirit comes upon them?
True or false: Jesus tells the apostles they will be His witnesses in Jerusalem only.
Starting in Jerusalem and going through all Judea and Samaria, how far does Jesus say the apostles' witness will reach?

answers.text: To the ends of the earth
To the banks of the Jordan

cards.text: Jesus finishes speaking. And right there, as the apostles watch, He is taken up.

cards.question: As Jesus is taken up, a ___ hides Him from the apostles' sight.

cards.text: They're looking intently into the sky as He goes. You know when you watch a plane shrink to a dot, and then you just keep staring at the empty spot anyway? Yeah. Like that.

cards.question: True or false: While the apostles are staring into the sky, two men dressed in white suddenly stand beside them.

cards.text: "Men of Galilee," they say, "why do you stand here looking into the sky?"

cards.question: What do the two men in white tell the apostles about Jesus?

answers.text: He will come back the same way He went
They will not see Him again on earth
They should go look for Him in Galilee

findings.problem: The opening card has 4 sentences: 'The writer of Acts opens…', 'That book was about…', 'Began, friend.' and 'And it ran right up to one VERY big day.'

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on.

findings.problem: The card tells part of Acts 1:2 ('it ran right up to one VERY big day' is the 'until the day' of verse 2), but it cites only Acts 1:1.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

findings.problem: The question opens with 'Instead of leaving Jerusalem', and that setup rules out the wrong answer 'Head out and preach in every town', because preaching in every town means leaving.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: This story card tells nothing new from the passage. It only reacts to the card 9 answer and restates it ('These folks are waiting on a promise straight from the Father').

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The setup says Jesus 'compares the Father's gift to John baptizing with water.' Acts 1:5 sets John's water baptism against the coming Spirit baptism. It is a contrast, not a comparison, and the card names the connection more firmly than the text does.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'living water' is a near-match for 'Holy Spirit'. John 7:38-39 explains living water as the Spirit, so a baker could argue it is right.

rule.text: A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

findings.problem: This story card tells nothing new from the passage. It only reacts to the question already covered on card 2.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The blank sentence says 'fixed by the ___ by His own authority.' The singular 'His' rules out the plural wrong answers 'angels' and 'prophets', so only 'Father' fits.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: This story card tells nothing new from the passage. It restates the card 5 answer ('The timing belongs to the Father') and adds a reaction.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The question says the witness goes 'through all Judea and Samaria.' That setup rules out the wrong answer 'To the borders of Judea', because Samaria already lies beyond it.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The card is only the bare quote, with no Papa Dorin voice around it.

rule.text: Short, but not stripped down. A story card still has enough of Papa Dorin's voice and enough context that the moment makes sense.
